# DX Living

> DX Living is an Australian project control specialist firm that combines project planning with immersive visualisation to de-risk high-end residential projects before construction begins. Based in Scoresby, Victoria, and operating across Australia, DX Living turns drawings and BIM data into 3D, 4D, interactive and VR environments so developers, architects, custom builders, suppliers and homeowners can review layout, sequencing and real supplier finishes, then decide with certainty rather than assumption. DX Living is the high-end residential division of FeelDX.

## What DX Living is and is not

- DX Living **is** a project control specialist firm: project planning (programme of works, 4D sequencing, plan-versus-actual) combined with visualisation (3D, 4D, interactive models, renders, flythroughs, VR).
- DX Living **is not** an architecture practice, a project management firm, a builder or contractor, or an interior design studio. It does not design homes, manage projects or build them.
- The purpose of every output is de-risking: fewer late design changes, fewer construction variations, better budget predictability and clearer stakeholder alignment before work starts.

- [Contact](https://dxliving.com/contact): Discovery call bookings and direct enquiries.

## Modules

- [DX Studio](https://dxliving.com/studio): The core planning and visualisation module. Converts drawings and BIM data into immersive 3D and 4D environments that show scale, flow, design intent and construction sequencing. Used by architects, custom builders and developers during early design and planning.
- [DX Interiors](https://dxliving.com/interiors): Real material and finish visualisation. Tiles, stone, cabinetry, lighting, furniture and appliances shown at full scale inside the model, with real-time swapping and side-by-side option comparison so selections are locked once rather than revisited on site.
- [DX Models](https://dxliving.com/model): Interactive presentation and sales module for off-the-plan sales, display suites, buyer walkthroughs and configuration experiences, with VR-compatible navigation.
- [DX Prestige](https://dxliving.com/prestige): The unified top tier combining DX Studio, DX Interiors and DX Models into one coordinated workflow for complex, high-value residential projects.
